senses.gloss: m.(b. h. כֹּר; כרר , v. כָּרָה) [a heap,] Khor, a measure of capacity, בֵּית כ׳ (or כ׳, sub. בית) an area requiring a Khor of seed.
units: B. Mets. 105ᵇ כ׳ זרע a field requiring a Khor of seed; כ׳ תבואה a field yielding a Khor of grain.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 105b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>ד׳ סאין לכ׳</he> four S’ah of seed for a Beth Khor of land, v. <cite ref="N01044"><he>נְפִילָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:1">B. Bath. VII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:2">2</cite> <he>בית כ׳</he>.
Ib. 104ᵃ נותן … לכל כ׳ וכ׳ we allow a surplus or deficit of seven Kab and a half for each Beth Khor; a. fr.—Du. כּוֹרַיִים, כּוֹרַיִם.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 104b:2">Ib.ᵇ</cite>—Ohol. VIII, 3; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:1">Kel. XV, 1</cite> <he>ארבעים סאה בלח שהן כ׳ ביבש</he> forty S’ah in liquid measure which is equal to two Khor in dry measure.
